frozen_rule: RL (roll12relay) replaces G (roll12cancel) as the arithmetic default if RL has 0 wrong, RL solved >= G solved, and RL answers at least as many cases through escalation agents as G. Cost and wall are reported, not gated (owner priority: quality).
disclosure: Weaknesses that remain in arms.py-driven arms (arms.py is pinned; disclose in reports): flush_caches ignores the ssh exit status and the HTTP status (only the response text is recorded), delta() accepts negative deltas after a counter reset, parse() counts a missing counter as 0 and accepts non-finite values, wait_idle() returns a busy snapshot after its limit without failing, and an energy failure does not change the exit code.
design_disclosure: Design notes: (1) G and RL share slots 0-3 exactly (seeds, nodes, prompts); escalation agents run on the node of the agent whose end freed their slot, so their nodes can differ between arms; (2) each request's sampling seed hashes the prompt, so RL's escalation agents (prompt + relayed work) sample differently from G's even with equal agent seeds; (3) the relayed work is chosen by seeded uniform sampling among the case's already failed agents, never by content; (4) the plan's code_sha256 pins are records checked by review, not enforced by the runner.
